title: Accessibility services
summary: This page provides information and links to various accessibility services offered by Service NSW, including language support and interpreting services.

internal_links.text: Book an interpreter for spoken language
Book Auslan video remote interpreting at a service centre
Book live captioning services at a service centre

faqs.q: How can I get help in my language?
faqs.a: You can find information on getting help in your language via the Service NSW website.

faqs.q: How do I book an interpreter for spoken language?
faqs.a: You can book an interpreter for spoken language through the Service NSW website.

faqs.q: What if I need document translation services?
faqs.a: You can apply for document translation services through the Service NSW website.

faqs.q: How can I book Auslan video remote interpreting?
faqs.a: You can book Auslan video remote interpreting at a service centre.

faqs.q: Do you offer live captioning services?
faqs.a: Yes, you can book live captioning services at a service centre.
